architectural_terms.HLL: internal Corporation language for truth, provenance, ratification, conflict and allowed Brain actions
architectural_terms.Quality_Control: independent cross-corporate quality gate below Harmonia Constitution
architectural_terms.Provider_Fabric: replaceable capability/provider composition layer with combos, skills and non-paid/sovereign fallback policy
architectural_terms.Corporate_Communication: declared typed dependency graph with HLL-gated material handoffs and cross-cutting observers
architectural_terms.Accountability_Contract: strict role responsibility, forbidden scope, confirmations, consequences and escalation
architectural_terms.Skill_Adaptation: Koordynator binds task-specific skills without exceeding the officially supported model capability ceiling
architectural_terms.Failure_Memory: durable recurrence, root-cause, failed-attempt and do-not-repeat memory
architectural_terms.Solution_Memory: durable verified solution patterns with applicability, contraindications, reliability and cost history
architectural_terms.Plugin_Core: stable constitutional core with replaceable executors, providers, verifiers, skill sources and transports
architectural_terms.HLL_Epistemic_Loop: prevention, diagnosis, verification and falsification around material corporate claims and work
architectural_terms.Novelty_Intake: pluggable multi-source absorption layer feeding Corporate Intelligence, Innovation Radar and Scientific Research
architectural_terms.Portfolio: simultaneous products, programs and projects with dependencies, priority and capacity allocation
architectural_terms.Growth_Operations: channel discovery, contacts, campaigns and gated external outreach with legal/QC/finance/authorisation controls
architectural_terms.Receipt_Binding: string/boolean/enum is not proof; material decisions bind exact statement, payload, scope, authority epoch and artifact via tamper-evident receipts
architectural_terms.Transactional_Audit: Corporation mutations use revisioned atomic state+event commits when the journal store is wired
architectural_terms.Execution_Isolation: candidate code work is prepared in leased ephemeral git worktrees; real executor wiring remains blocked until sandbox boundaries are complete
architectural_terms.Blind_Execution: executor receives only stage-scoped inputs, bounded micro-operations, a capability lease and an opaque authoritative stage-contract binding; it emits evidence, not truth
architectural_terms.Dynamic_HLL_Synthesis: authoritative HLL Engine derives semantic state from trace/artifacts/effects/evidence; Koordynator does not implement a competing local truth engine
architectural_terms.Deterministic_Group_Chat: multi-agent group chat uses frozen-round alphabetical cyclic scheduling; first-response-wins is forbidden and membership changes enter only next round

invariants: Unratified propositions are not executable corporate truth
Koordynator executes only HLL-allowed Brain actions
Role activation requires a healthy executor within capability/effect/tool ceiling
Dynamic organizational roles do not depend on the legacy TaskRole enum
Autonomous code repair must use isolated ephemeral worktrees
Solution selection means best verified available candidate
No automatic secret scraping, paid fallback activation, OAuth consent, billing change, destructive action, production deployment or protected merge
Koordynator MUST NOT mint, synthesize or ratify HLL truth independently of the authoritative HLL Engine
Blind execution produces trace/artifact/effect/evidence only; semantic truth and next-stage authority come from HLL/VERA
Multi-agent group chat speaking order is deterministic alphabetical round-robin; provider latency never determines who speaks next
recovery_sequence: Inspect src/corporation/runtime-authorities.ts and the HLL/VERA authority transports
Continue from the first pending runtime/executor item without recreating HLL or VERA locally
authoritative_hll_note: Do not reconstruct HLL inside Koordynator. Corporation uses the stateful CorporationHllAuthority extension built on Harmonia-Legal-Platform develop, while downstream canonical use revalidates decision and record receipts.
head_resolution: Resolve current branch HEAD from Git/CI at runtime; do not persist a manual current HEAD inside this manifest.
hll_adapter_blocker: Semantic authority protocol, stable Corporation identity mapping, typed relation mapping v1, stateful transport and shared downstream truth boundary are implemented. Remaining blocker is application/runtime bootstrap wiring plus the deliberately blocked executor/sandbox/verifier layers.
